# PF-44 Pigment Ink

Hesselwood Ink Co. product page, revised 2026-05-30.

PF-44 is our deep-black pigment cartridge for the Studio 40 and Studio 60 ranges. It is sealed against drying and ships in a recyclable shell.

The rated page yield, shell weight and shelf life are listed in the specification table on this page.
